verdict.rationale: DPMA documents DPMAregister as its official public register for patents, utility models, trade marks and designs, which is the right surface for a founder to look up a filing. However, the evidence is a single one-line listing and never says that status details (pending, examination stage, granted, refused) can be viewed per application. The probe only confirms the register host exists; its content was not fetched. Missing for 10: documentation that the register shows per-application status, a description of how to search by application number or owner, and hands-on or independent confirmation of status lookup.
